title: Measuring Misogyny in Natural Language Generation: Preliminary Results from a Case Study on two Reddit Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text generated by models fine-tuned on specific Reddit communities (r/Incels and r/ForeverAlone) using a misogyny-specific lexicon (Farrell lexicon) that detects categories such as 'Patriarchy', 'Belittling', and 'Sexual Violence', as well as comparing these results against generic toxicity classifiers.
Evaluating generated text using the 'Homophobia' category included within the Farrell lexicon framework to detect bias in model outputs.
Evaluating generated text using the 'Racism' category included within the Farrell lexicon framework to detect bias in model outputs.
